name: Amadora BD
blurb: One of Portugal's largest comics festivals, held across Amadora's Parque da Liberdade with international guest authors, contests and exhibitions.

textOnlyGuests: Creator of comic strip O Menino Triste
Dinosaur Comics, The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl
editions.evidence: Official municipal page title: 'Amadora BD'26 - 15 a 25 de outubro' (cm-amadora.pt); venue from the con's own homepage: 'Como chegar? Parque da Liberdade – Núcleo Central, Rua Carvalho Araújo, s/n 2720-087 Damaia, Amadora'.

notes: amadorabd.com is a one-page WordPress site: nav items (Localização, Visitar, Autores) are in-page anchors, not real URLs — /localizacao/, /visitar/ and /autores/ all 404, and the homepage's own guest-mode scan turned up only contest banners and venue photos, no guest portraits. Dates were confirmed instead on the organizer's own city-hall page (cm-amadora.pt, Câmara Municipal da Amadora runs the festival per amadorabd.com's footer) rather than the batch's guessed '16-25 Oct' — the festival actually runs 2026-10-15 to 10-25, with most guest-author programming on the two weekends of Oct 16-18 and Oct 23-25. The 19 invited authors (per a centralcomics.com recap of the official announcement, since no photo gallery could be reached within budget) are recorded as textOnlyGuests; 'known for' is filled in only where I have confident, specific knowledge of the person's work and left blank otherwise rather than guessed — all are categorised 'comics' since the festival only invites comics writers/artists in this slot. 'Pedro N.' is exactly how the source credited that guest (likely a truncated byline).
